description: Candidate models for the llama.cpp/GGUF reasoning path (see PocketRAG_Snapdragon_Implementation_Plan.md and llama_runtime.dart). Side-loaded via Office Kit, same as the existing Gemma/MediaPipe model — no in-app downloader, no INTERNET permission added for this. Downloaded and verified on 2026-09-13.

models.notes: Official Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B-GGUF only ships Q8_0; unsloth is the widely-used, llama.cpp-community-standard source for K-quants of this model.
First-party source — HuggingFaceTB is the model's own publishing org, and this repo ships the Q4_K_M quant directly.

notCollectedYet.role: current baseline / quality reference, per the PocketRAG plan
notCollectedYet.reason: Gemma already runs via the working MediaPipe path (llm_runtime.dart); a GGUF copy is only needed for a direct cross-runtime comparison, which is lower priority than proving the two genuinely new models.
